title: Governed Production promotion identity and certified release-cut classifier adapter

phases.objective: Make the deterministic release-cut identity emitted by the governed Production promotion controller a first-class certified classifier identity, centralize session and surface derivation, preserve older run-bound and legacy namespaces as compatibility-only paths, and require one exact two-parent release-cut topology without mutating remote refs or requiring current main to remain equal to the certified cut.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A governed Production candidate uses the deterministic release/production-candidate-<release-cut-12>-<Production-12> surface emitted by the release-cut controller, or an explicitly retained run-bound certified compatibility surface, and targets the exact pinned Production SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The candidate is accepted only when its surface hint agrees with the exact Git graph, it is the exact two-parent immutable release-cut candidate, its tree equals the release-cut tree, pinned Production remains exact, Production is contained by the release cut, and the release cut remains an ancestor of current main even when main has advanced.
steps: Derive deterministic operation/session identity from exact release-cut and Production SHAs without using GitHub run IDs as operation identity.
Parse the controller-owned deterministic release-cut namespace as the canonical current surface and retain the previously certified run-bound namespace only as compatibility input.
Keep legacy bridge/push and SHA-bound candidate handling delegated to the preserved legacy evaluator rather than broadening the new certified namespace.
Read current main and Production through the same authenticated read-only protected-ref transport used by the existing classifier, or tokenless git ls-remote only in synthetic/local execution.
Require current Production to equal the PR base exactly and to match the embedded Production hint.
Require exactly two candidate parents: certified release cut first and pinned Production second.
Require the exact candidate tree to equal the release-cut tree byte-for-byte and require Production to be an ancestor of the certified release cut.
Allow current main to advance only while the certified release cut remains its ancestor.

Evaluate the candidate through an isolated temporary Git clone whose local canonical-main ref is pinned to the certified release cut, preserving the reviewed legacy semantic evaluator without altering remote refs.
Require the certified validation workflow to enforce the same exact two-parent topology rather than accepting an arbitrary third parent.

Reject stale Production, release-cut ancestry loss, wrong trees, malformed prefixes, wrong parent order/count, malformed branch identities, session-prefix mismatch, and legacy mirror content drift fail closed.
assertions: The deterministic branch shape produced by the current governed launcher is accepted only after exact graph validation; branch prefixes are hints, never authority.
GitHub run IDs and run attempts are evidence metadata and are not required to identify a deterministic promotion session.
The adapter does not broaden legacy SHA-bound or bridge candidate namespaces.
Remote main, Production, candidate, and protected refs are never mutated.
Current main equality with the release cut is not required; release-cut ancestry is required instead.
Production must remain exactly equal to the pinned base SHA.
The candidate tree must remain byte-identical to the certified release cut.
The candidate must have exactly two parents and preserve Production as its exact second parent and the release cut as its exact first parent.
The exact deterministic identity pattern used by Production release PR #7964 is covered by the synthetic classifier regression.
Legacy classifier behavior remains delegated unchanged for every non-certified-release-cut branch identity.
The legacy configuration mirror is excluded from duplicate discovery only for its reviewed SHA-256; changing any byte removes that exemption automatically.
No deployment, SQL, migration Apply, grant, provider call, credential payload read, external send, protected-ref write, Production merge, or force update occurs.

phases.objective: Observe deterministic and compatibility release-cut identities on governed Production candidate PR events while preserving exact protected-ref readback and one promotion session per release-cut/Production pair.
Retain fail-closed diagnostics for protected-ref transport failure, ancestry loss, malformed candidate identity, session mismatch, parent drift, and tree drift.
Validate the exact #7964 deterministic release surface plus advanced-main, stale-Production, third-parent, wrong-tree, and spoofed-prefix negative cases before Production promotion.
Require exact classifier evidence on a fresh deterministic governed Production candidate without granting merge, deployment, database, or provider authority.
